purpose: Causal same-tape training test of one backlog-specific placement normalization change after the complete V184 confirmation failure.

mechanistic_hypothesis.observed_failure: V184 retains a throughput advantage but loses QPR through higher request latency in high operational queue-density windows.
mechanistic_hypothesis.current_high_density_penalty: OCS current-demand load uses x/(1+x), which compresses every large candidate-node task load toward one and weakens high-pressure load discrimination.
mechanistic_hypothesis.single_intervention: At operational queue density at least 8 only, retain the OCS warm-container, memory-headroom, and recent-affinity terms and their frozen weights, but replace x/(1+x) with candidate_task_load/max_feasible_candidate_task_load. Below 8 retain the exact V182 Hiku2/OCS Borda branch.
unchanged: social-welfare equations and offline reference definition
V182 queue8 lone-heavy terminal admission guard
OCS warm-container, memory, affinity weights and tie-breaking
workload tapes, cluster, HPA, load profile and observation window

candidate.tape_reuse: Reuse the immutable V184 E1590-E1609 base tapes after hash verification.
candidate.control_reuse: Reuse all twenty immutable V184 candidate summaries as the paired control; do not rerun V182.
candidate.reference_action: Build or bind policy-independent references only through the fail-closed protocol dependency rules for the new runtime identity.

disposition.on_pass: Freeze the candidate as training winner and preregister a later disjoint NSESche-only confirmation cohort; do not claim low closure from E1590-E1609.
disposition.on_fail: Retain the complete cohort, seal a failure receipt, close this mechanism axis, and do not advance to middle.
